name: infernal_horseman
description: an Infernal Horseman, a red-skinned demon with two curved dark horns and yellow eyes in black plate armour with gold trim, a round black shield with a gold rim and an orange flame emblem on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped spear with a dark wooden shaft in his LEFT hand, riding a black horse with glowing red eyes, a mane and tail of orange and yellow flame, a gold-studded harness and gold-banded black hooves
hands: the spear stays in the demon's left hand on the screen-right side and the round black shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
